## Data exclusions

Mark participants which may have participated several times (except if first time was completed)
```{r}

exclusions <- raw_data %>%
  #participants are allowed to read the instructions twice but not pages with manipulation
  #thus, only inspect trials where participants got to page four or above
  filter(MAXPAGE > 3) %>%
  
  # filter for duplicated prolific ids
  group_by(prolificID) %>%
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
  
  # get participants who completed on the second or later try
  # incomplete tries are excluded anyway
  arrange(STARTED) %>%
  filter(STARTED != min(STARTED) & MAXPAGE >= 11) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # get reason for exclusion and save IDs for exclusion
  mutate(reason = "not completed on first try") %>%
  select(CASE, reason)
```

Check if there are participants that retracted consent
```{r}
exclusions %<>% 
  bind_rows(raw_data %>% 
              filter(data.usage == 2) %>%
              mutate(reason = "retracted consent") %>%
              select(CASE, reason))
```

Exclude 3 participants: CASE 142 (technical problems) and CASES 485 and 510 (could not focus)
```{r}
exclusions %<>%
  bind_rows(raw_data %>% 
              filter(CASE %in% c(142, 485, 510)) %>% 
              mutate(reason = "technical issues") %>% 
              select(CASE, reason))
```

Compute window change indicator
TODO: Do we plan exclusions based on this?

```{r}
raw_data <- raw_data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(window.changes = sum(c_across(WC01_01 : WC03_24))) %>%
  ungroup()
```

remove participants who meet exclusion criteria
```{r}
raw_data <- filter(raw_data, !CASE %in% exclusions$CASE)
```


Filter for participants to have reached last page and answered last question (final consent): complete cases
```{r}
raw_data <- filter(raw_data, MAXPAGE >= 11, !is.na(data.usage))
```

Remove prolific IDs
```{r}
raw_data$prolificID <- NA
```

## Data Wrangling
Select and extract relevant variables, convert to long format
```{r}
data_long <- raw_data %>%
  select(CASE, starts_with("attention.check"), vignette_1:citation.text_24, starts_with("quality.rating")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = attention.check_1:quality.rating_24, 
               names_to = c(".value", "item"),
               names_sep = "_")
```

Evaluate attention checks - exclude if less than 4 passed
```{r}
exclusions %<>%
  bind_rows(
    data_long %>%
      filter(item %in% c(1:6)) %>%
      # recode attention checks
      mutate(attention.check = ifelse(item %in% c(2,3,5,6) & attention.check == 2, 0, attention.check),
             ac.passed = case_when(item %in% c(1,4) ~ attention.check == 1,
                                   item %in% c(2,5) ~ attention.check == confirmation,
                                   item %in% c(3,6) ~ attention.check == quality)) %>%
      group_by(CASE) %>%
      summarise(ac.passed = sum(ac.passed)) %>%
      filter(ac.passed < 4) %>%
      mutate(reason = "attention check failed") %>%
      select(CASE, reason))
```

Exclude if attention check failed
```{r}
raw_data <- filter(raw_data, !CASE %in% exclusions$CASE)
data_long <- filter(data_long, !CASE %in% exclusions$CASE)
```

Total number of excluded participants
```{r}
length(exclusions$CASE)
```
Number of remaining participants
```{r}
length(unique(raw_data$CASE))
```

Compute IV: Rename and code quality indicator variables
```{r}
data_long %<>%
  mutate(title_r = ifelse(title == "Prof.", 1, 0),
         institution_r = ifelse(institution %in% c("Harvard University", 
                                                   "Stanford University",
                                                   "Cornell University",
                                                   "University of California, Berkeley",
                                                   "University of Michigan",
                                                   "University of Washington",
                                                   "Columbia University",
                                                   "University of Pennsylvania",
                                                   "Yale University",
                                                   "Princeton University"),
                                1, 0),
         vignette_r = ifelse(vignette %in% c("VI01", "VI02"), 1, 0)) #1 = long vignette, 0 = short vignette
```

Compute DV: Filter out missing quality ratings and recode
```{r}
data_long <- data_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(quality.rating)) %>%
  mutate(quality.rating = (quality.rating-1)/100)
```

## Analysis

### Descriptives
```{r}
desc <- data_long %>%
  select(CASE, vignette, quality.rating, title_r, institution_r, confirmation, quality, prestige, opendata, citation, vignette_r) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = title_r:vignette_r, names_to = "indicator", values_to = "indicator_value")

desc_avg <- desc %>%
  group_by(CASE, indicator, indicator_value) %>%
  summarise(qr_ind = mean(quality.rating)) %>%
  group_by(indicator, indicator_value) %>%
  summarise(qr = mean(qr_ind), se = sd(qr_ind)) %>%
  group_by(indicator) %>%
  mutate(diff = qr - lag(qr)) %>%
  mutate(diff = if_else(is.na(diff), lead(diff), diff)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(diff)) %>%
  mutate(indicator_value = if_else(indicator_value == 0, "low", "high")) %>%
  mutate(indicator_value = factor(indicator_value, levels = c("low", "high")),
         indicator = factor(indicator, 
                            levels = unique(indicator), 
                            labels = c("Quality comment", "Citation", "Open data", "Hypothesis confirmation", "Vignette length", "Institution", "Journal prestige", "Title")))
```

```{r}
p_qr <- ggplot(data = desc_avg, mapping = aes(x = indicator, y = qr, fill = indicator_value, group = indicator_value)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(.9)) +
  geom_errorbar(mapping = aes(ymin = qr-se, ymax = qr+se), width = .2, position = position_dodge(.9)) +
  theme_classic() +
  ylim(c(0,1)) +
  labs(y = "Quality rating",
       x = "Indicator",
       fill = "Predictor manifestation") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p_qr
# ggsave(p_qr, file = here("pilot2/plot_qr.svg"), height = 10, width = 15, limitsize = FALSE)
```

```{r}
desc2 <- data_long %>%
  select(CASE, vignette, quality.rating, title_r, institution_r, confirmation, quality, prestige, opendata, citation, vignette_r) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = title_r:citation, names_to = "indicator", values_to = "indicator_value")

desc2_avg <- desc2 %>%

                            levels = c("quality", "citation", "opendata", "confirmation", "institution_r", "prestige", "title_r"),

ggplot(data = desc2_avg, mapping = aes(x = indicator, y = qr, fill = indicator_value, group = indicator_value)) +
```

### Mixed linear model analysis
Effect coding
```{r}
data_long$title_r <- data_long$title_r - 0.5
data_long$institution_r <- data_long$institution_r - 0.5
data_long$confirmation <- data_long$confirmation - 0.5
data_long$quality <- data_long$quality - 0.5
data_long$prestige <- data_long$prestige - 0.5
data_long$opendata <- data_long$opendata - 0.5
data_long$citation <- data_long$citation - 0.5
data_long$vignette_r <- data_long$vignette_r - 0.5
```

Fit model
```{r}
mod_inter <- lmer(quality.rating ~ title_r + institution_r + confirmation + quality + prestige + opendata + citation + vignette_r + title_r:vignette_r + institution_r:vignette_r + confirmation:vignette_r + quality:vignette_r + prestige:vignette_r + opendata:vignette_r + citation:vignette_r + (1|CASE) +(1|item), data = data_long)
summary(mod_inter)
```
Waldian confidence intervals for fixed effects
```{r}
CIWald <- confint(mod_inter, method = "Wald", oldNames = FALSE)
CIWald
```
Bootstrapped confidence intervals for random effects
```{r}
set.seed(42)
CIboot <- confint(mod_inter, method = 'boot', nsim = 2000, oldNames=FALSE)
CIboot
```

Conditional and marginal R^2
```{r}
r2(mod_inter)
```

ICC
```{r}
icc(mod_inter)
```
With random slopes
Removed random slopes for vignette_r, confirmation, title_r, institution_r, and prestige to achieve convergence and prevent singular fit
```{r}
mod_rs <- lmer(quality.rating ~ title_r + institution_r + confirmation + quality + prestige + opendata + citation + vignette_r + title_r:vignette_r + institution_r:vignette_r + confirmation:vignette_r + quality:vignette_r + prestige:vignette_r + opendata:vignette_r + citation:vignette_r + (1+quality+opendata+citation|CASE) +(1|item), data = data_long)
summary(mod_rs)
```

### Direct Rating of Quality Indicators
```{r}
qi <- raw_data %>%
  select(CASE, quality.indicator_1:quality.indicator_6) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = quality.indicator_1:quality.indicator_6, 
               names_to = c("name", "indicator"),
               names_sep = "_") %>%
  select(-name) %>%
  mutate(indicator_txt = case_when(
    indicator == 1 ~ "title",
    indicator == 2 ~ "institution",
    indicator == 3 ~ "quality",
    indicator == 4 ~ "prestige",
    indicator == 5 ~ "opendata",
    indicator == 6 ~ "citation")) %>%
  mutate(value = value-1) %>%
  mutate(indicator_txt = factor(indicator_txt, levels = c("quality", "citation", "opendata", "prestige", "institution", "title"), labels = c("Quality comment", "Citation", "Open data", "Journal prestige", "Institution", "Title")))

qi_avg <- qi %>%
  group_by(CASE, indicator_txt) %>%
  summarise(mean_ind = mean(value)) %>%
  group_by(indicator_txt) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(mean_ind), se = sd(mean_ind)) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean))
```

```{r}
p_qi <- ggplot(data = qi_avg, mapping = aes(x = indicator_txt, y = mean)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(.9), fill = "grey60") +
  geom_errorbar(mapping = aes(ymin = mean-se, ymax = mean+se), width = .2, position = position_dodge(.9)) +
  theme_classic() +
  ylim(c(0,6)) +
  labs(x = "Quality indicator",
       y = "Importance rating") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3.5, linetype = "dashed")
p_qi
# ggsave(p_qi, file = here("pilot2/plot_qi.svg"), height = 10, width = 15, limitsize = FALSE)
```

Analyze whether importance ratings are higher for selected quality indicators than for non-selected quality indicators
```{r}
# contrast coding
qi <- qi %>%
  mutate(importance_contr = if_else(indicator_txt %in% c("Quality comment", "Open data", "citation"), 0.5, -0.5))

# mixed linear model
mod_importance <- lmer(value ~ importance_contr + (1|CASE), data = qi)
summary(mod_importance)
```
```{r}
confint(mod_importance, method = "Wald", oldNames = FALSE)
```

Bootstrapped confidence intervals for random effects
```{r}
set.seed(42)
CIboot <- confint(mod_importance, method = 'boot', nsim = 2000, oldNames=FALSE)
CIboot
```

Conditional and marginal R^2
```{r}
r2(mod_importance)
```

ICC
```{r}
icc(mod_importance)
```
